Continuing Education Credits

Empowering Your Practice Through Accredited Education

The K-Beauty Aesthetic Summit is committed to providing high-level, evidence-based education that meets the professional requirements of our attendees. This one-day program is designed to deliver immediate clinical value while helping you maintain your professional certifications.

Anticipated Credits

6

CME/CE Hours

Full-day course

10

Eligible Sessions

Out of 13 daily sessions

1

Full Day

Comprehensive education

👥 Target Audience

These credits are intended for a broad range of medical professionals, including:

  • Physicians and Dermatologists

  • Plastic and Facial Plastic Surgeons

  • Nurse Practitioners and Physician Assistants

  • Aesthetic Nurses and Nurse Injectors

🎯 Educational Objectives

Upon completion of the summit, attendees will be able to:

1. Integration of K-Beauty Philosophy

Integrate Korean aesthetic philosophies of harmony and subtle enhancement into Western clinical practice.

2. Advanced Injectable Techniques

Implement advanced micro-dosing and synergistic layering techniques using neurotoxins and skin boosters.

3. Comprehensive Treatment Planning

Develop comprehensive treatment plans using PDO threads, regenerative aesthetics, and next-generation energy devices.

📋 How to Claim Your Credits

Follow these simple steps to ensure you receive your CME/CE credits:

1

Sign In at Registration

Please ensure you sign in at the registration desk upon arrival to verify your attendance. This is essential for credit documentation.

Attend Eligible Sessions

Participate in the 10 CME-eligible sessions throughout the day. Full attendance is required to receive the maximum 6 hours of credit.

Complete Evaluation

Fill out the course evaluation form at the end of the summit. This feedback helps us improve future educational offerings.

Receive Certificate

Instructions on how to claim your CME/CE credits and access your certificate will be provided directly to all registered attendees following the conclusion of the event.

2

3

4

ℹ️ Additional Information

✔ Credit Distribution: Credits will be distributed electronically within 30 days following the summit.

✔ Documentation: Keep your registration confirmation and attendance verification for your records.

✔ Questions: For specific questions about CME/CE accreditation, please contact us at info@kbeautyaestheticsummit.com

✔ Updates: Registered attendees will receive updates on accreditation status via email.
